topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Biology and Course Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines the learning outcomes, and previews the core themes of tumor development, histology, and clinical diagnosis.

topics.label: Cancer as a Stepwise Failure of Differentiation and Tissue Architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops through accumulated genetic and epigenetic changes that disrupt normal cellular differentiation programs and three-dimensional tissue organization.

topics.label: Distinguishing Benign and Malignant Tumors through Invasion and Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define malignancy by contrasting well-contained benign tumors with invasive and metastatic neoplasms that spread to distant anatomical sites.

topics.label: Stepwise Progression in Colorectal Cancer and Clinical Risks of Benign Tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics illustrate the morphological progression from benign polyps to invasive adenocarcinoma in the colon while exploring the clinical complications caused by non-malignant growths.

topics.label: Conventions and Exceptions in Tumor Nomenclature
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the standard naming rules and exceptions used to classify benign and malignant tumors according to their tissue of origin.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Morbidity and Mortality in Cancer Patients
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how primary and metastatic tumors cause severe illness and death through local mechanical obstruction, tissue destruction, and systemic metabolic effects.

topics.label: Cancer Incidence in Humans and Across Animal Species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the epidemiological distribution and mortality of common human cancers while highlighting cancer occurrence across diverse multicellular animal taxa.

topics.label: Principles and Evaluation of Cancer Screening Programs
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the clinical presentation of tumors and evaluate the diagnostic methods, efficacy, and limitations of screening across different organ systems.

topics.label: Conclusion and Review of Key Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by directing students to review the learning outcomes before upcoming practical sessions.
